summary: A SuperAdmin decides whether PIM Manager may delete groups, and sees how many before confirming.

new.title: Switch for group deletion
new.text: A SuperAdmin can switch group deletion on in Settings > Approvals & policy > Group deletion. The confirmation says how many groups will be deleted.

fixes.title: Groups waiting for deletion are clear
fixes.text: A group marked for deletion shows as waiting to be deleted, with the reason. Texts that pointed at a missing menu now point at the right one.
